name: Coupled Spring Simulation
description: Chains and branches of masses on springs, drawn in pygame with each spring coloured by how stretched (blue) or compressed (red) it is.
highlights: Each mass is integrated with SciPy's adaptive Runge–Kutta solver (DOP853)
Springs can hang from other masses, and child springs pull back on their parents
A slider sets the time step while it runs, including negative steps that run the simulation backwards
